description: Policy lint rules. Implements the no-claims rule in docs/legal-policy/README.md and policy 07. A claim of compliance, certification, Canadian residency or no recording is a legal conclusion the product cannot support; write 'implements control X for obligation Y' instead.

forbiddenClaims.message: Compliance claim. Describe the control and the obligation instead.
Certification claim. CollectRx holds no certification.
Residency claim. No vendor Canadian processing region is confirmed.
Residency claim. No vendor Canadian processing region is confirmed.
Recording claim. Transcripts and vendor logs exist; state what is actually stored.
